caption:
A witch buries two pranksters in snow.
Seedance 2.5 animated this whole chase.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 20 seconds. 16:9 widescreen. 2D anime style, painterly cel-shaded look with soft gradients, cinematic lighting: deep blue night with warm amber glowing windows and lanterns, falling snowflakes, light bloom, snow-spray particles. Camera feel: dynamic anime cinematography, low angles, fast tracking during the chase, punchy close-ups. Pacing: quick comic setup, a fast chase, a smug beat, then a big snow-trap payoff.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WITCH: stern young woman, pale skin, sharp violet eyes, long jet-black hair in a single thick loose braid down her back with loose strands framing her face. Deep plum hooded winter cloak with a silver clasp, cream-and-plum checked scarf, dark dress beneath, black leather gloves, black boots. Signature: the braid whipping behind her and an unimpressed cold glare.
- THE TWIN PRANKSTERS: two identical mischievous teenage boys, tanned freckled skin, messy curly dark-brown hair, cheeky grins. Forest-green duffle coats with wooden toggles, long teal-and-white striped knit scarves, grey fingerless gloves. Twin A wears brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead; Twin B has no goggles.

LOCATION: a snowy gothic stone castle courtyard at night: a tiered stone fountain frozen solid with long icicles, pointed stone arcades and archways, tall windows glowing warm gold, iron lanterns, a long arcade roof piled thick with snow and lined with icicles, a lantern-lit vaulted stone corridor, a thick stone pillar capped with snow.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.5) — The set-up. Low-angle wide: the witch walks calmly through the courtyard in the left foreground, cloak swaying; behind her in the centre stands the frozen tiered fountain with icicles; the twins crouch behind its basin at right, peeking out and grinning. Snow falls gently.
SHOT 2 (00:01.5-00:02.4) — Close-up of Twin A (goggles) grinning wickedly, packing a round snowball in his fingerless gloves.
SHOT 3 (00:02.4-00:02.9) — Close-up of Twin A winding up and hurling the snowball straight toward camera, the snowball blurring large in the right foreground; a quick cut follows the snowball in flight.
SHOT 4 (00:02.9-00:04.1) — The hit. Close side/back view of the witch: the snowball smashes into the back of her shoulder and head in a burst of snow spray, her braid whipping, her eyes squeezed shut. MUST SHOW: a white explosion of snow powder on impact.
SHOT 5 (00:04.1-00:05.4) — The glare. Close-up of the witch's face in three-quarter view, snow clumped on her cloak and hood, slow push-in as her eyes snap open into a furious cold glare.
SHOT 6 (00:05.4-00:06.3) — The run. Wide tracking: the twins sprint away laughing across the snowy courtyard, cloaks of their coats flapping, snow and slush kicking up; the witch charges after them behind.
SHOT 7 (00:06.3-00:08.0) — The chase. Close side tracking shot at high speed: the witch sprints low and fast, leaning forward, braid streaming behind her, eyes narrowed, snow streaking past.
SHOT 8 (00:08.0-00:08.9) — Twin B, running, looks back over his shoulder with a grin and winds up another snowball over his shoulder.
SHOT 9 (00:08.9-00:10.3) — The dodge. Close tracking on the witch: a snowball flies in from the left; she ducks and it bursts in spray past her face without slowing her.
SHOT 10 (00:10.3-00:11.0) — The counter. Close-up: Twin A takes a snowball square in the face, snow exploding off his nose, eyes shut.
SHOT 11 (00:11.0-00:13.0) — Wide side tracking along a long arcade with a roof piled with snow and lined with icicles: the two twins race left to right past the stone columns with the witch close behind; the camera pans with them as they run out of frame, leaving the empty snowy arcade. MUST SHOW: the thick overhanging snow mass and icicles on the arcade roof.
SHOT 12 (00:13.0-00:14.2) — The celebration. Low angle in the lantern-lit vaulted stone corridor: the twins, breathless and laughing, jump into a high-five.
SHOT 13 (00:14.2-00:14.8) — The ambush. Dark corner beside the snow-capped stone pillar: the witch slides in low behind it, scooping up snow.
SHOT 14 (00:14.8-00:15.4) — Close-up of the witch packing a huge armful of snow, eyes cold and determined, a tiny smirk.
SHOT 15 (00:15.4-00:15.8) — Close-up of Twin A, smug and grinning, chin raised, unaware.
SHOT 16 (00:15.8-00:16.1) — Tighter close-up of Twin A grinning up at the sky.
SHOT 17 (00:16.1-00:16.6) — Behind the pillar, the witch swings her arm up toward the roof.
SHOT 18 (00:16.6-00:17.2) — Wide: the twins stand side by side under the arcade's overhanging snow-laden roof, glowing windows behind them.
SHOT 19 (00:17.2-00:18.4) — The trap. Wide: the whole mass of roof snow slides off in a thundering avalanche and buries the twins, only their flailing arms and gloved hands poking out of the pile. MUST SHOW: a massive white snow avalanche pouring down from the roof onto them.
SHOT 20 (00:18.4-00:20.1) — The payoff. Low-angle medium: the twins buried up to their necks in a snowbank at left, dazed sheepish grins; the witch stands tall at right in front of the glowing castle windows, chin raised, eyes closed, calmly tugging her gloves tight with a satisfied smirk. Snow keeps falling.

SOUND: no dialogue. Playful, bouncy orchestral score with pizzicato strings and light bells; snow crunching footsteps; muffled snickers and giggles from the twins; a soft whoosh and wet "poof" on each snowball hit; an indignant gasp from the witch; fast running footsteps during the chase; a slap on the high-five; a deep rumbling whoomph as the avalanche falls; then the twins' muffled groans and a final cheeky musical sting.
prompt_short: 20s 16:9 2D anime, snowy gothic castle courtyard at night. Two curly-haired twin pranksters hit a stern black-braided witch with a snowball; after a fast chase she triggers a roof avalanche that buries them to their necks. Warm windows, falling snow.
